name: piece-select
prompt: A single wooden chess piece lifted off a wooden chessboard, one light dry tap with a faint short slide, close and quiet.

name: piece-move
prompt: A wooden chess piece set down gently on a wooden chessboard, one soft solid knock with a short warm wood resonance.

name: piece-capture
prompt: A wooden chess piece knocking another piece off a wooden board, a firm double clack of wood on wood with a small tumble.

name: piece-castle
prompt: Two wooden chess pieces set down in quick succession on a wooden chessboard, two soft knocks a beat apart.

name: check-bell
prompt: A single small brass bell struck once, a clear short ting with a gentle decaying ring in a quiet room.

name: promote-chime
prompt: A short bright ascending glockenspiel triplet ending on a sustained high note with a soft shimmer tail.

name: illegal-knock
prompt: A dull muted knuckle knock on a wooden tabletop, two quick damped taps, refused and flat.

name: match-found
prompt: A small hotel desk bell struck once, bright and inviting, ringing out in a quiet carpeted room.

name: draw-offer
prompt: Two light polite fingertip taps on a polished wooden table, close and soft.

name: chat-note
prompt: A folded paper note slid quickly across a wooden table, a soft short paper swish ending in a faint tick.

name: clock-warning
prompt: A single mechanical chess clock tick followed by a short muted wooden click, in a silent room.

name: game-win
prompt: A warm rising three-note phrase on soft brass and clarinet resolving into a bright sustained major chord with quiet room reverb.

name: game-lose
prompt: Three slow descending soft piano notes fading quietly into silence, gentle and dignified.

name: game-draw
prompt: Two soft equal piano notes played together and held, a neutral suspended chord fading slowly.
